verdict.rationale: Retell documents several pre-production test surfaces: an LLM Playground with tool-call inspection, simulation and batch testing with graded test cases, free browser web-call testing that needs no phone number, and Conductor-run simulation tests that check changes without real phone calls. Draft and staging version tags let you test a new version while production stays on another. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the simulation/eval features, and testing runs in the production workspace at production rates rather than an isolated sandbox.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls

citations.quote: an LLM Playground with tool-call inspection, simulation/batch testing with graded test cases, browser web-call testing without a phone number, and phone-call testing
Conductor can run simulation tests that play out a scenario against your agent and show how it responds. This lets you check changes without making real phone calls.
This step is free and doesn't need a phone number or payment method.
A new version starts as a draft, which you can edit and test
